title: subscription.changed.v1 payload
description: An organization's subscription or entitlements changed. Consumers adjust feature gates, limits, and AI budgets (ADR-003). Emitted by the control plane via outbox after the billing transaction commits.

entitlements.description: Effective feature flags/limits snapshot (key → bool or numeric limit). Consumers treat this as authoritative until the next event.

ai_monthly_budget.description: Monthly AI spend cap in minor units; null = plan default (ADR-003).
